name: datax-pii
description: PII/PHI entity taxonomy. The label set is byte-for-byte the span-label vocabulary of nvidia/Nemotron-PII, so spans emitted against this taxonomy are directly comparable with that dataset.

compatibility.derivation: Distinct `label` values across all `spans` in both the train and test splits (100,000 rows each). Both splits yield exactly the same 55 labels. The dataset card says '55+ PII/PHI categories'; the measured vocabulary is exactly 55.

groups.identity: Names and account-scoped identifiers for a person.
groups.contact: Ways to reach a person or entity.
groups.government_id: Identifiers issued by a government or licensing authority.
groups.biometric: Measurements of the body used for identification.
groups.credential: Secrets that grant access to a system.
groups.network: Identifiers for a device or network endpoint.
groups.demographic: Attributes of a person, several of which are special-category data.
groups.temporal: Dates and times that can act as quasi-identifiers.

sensitivity_levels.critical: Direct compromise if disclosed: credentials, payment instruments, government IDs.
sensitivity_levels.high: Directly identifies an individual, or is special-category data under GDPR Art. 9.
sensitivity_levels.medium: Identifies an individual in combination with other fields.
sensitivity_levels.low: Quasi-identifier; rarely identifying on its own.

labels.description: A person's given name.
A person's family name or surname.
A login handle or screen name for an account or system.
An identifier assigned to a customer or client by an organization.
An identifier assigned to a worker by their employer.
A record, case, reference, or tracking identifier that is not covered by a more specific label.
An email address.
A telephone number, including mobile and landline.
A facsimile number.
A web address. PHI-relevant when it resolves to a person-specific resource.
A street-level postal address, including building and unit number.
A city, town, or municipality name.
A state, province, or top-level administrative region.
A county or equivalent second-level administrative region.
A country name or code.
A postal or ZIP code.
A geographic coordinate pair (latitude/longitude).
A U.S. Social Security Number.
A non-U.S. national identity number, passport number, or equivalent state-issued personal identifier.
A taxpayer identification number for a person or business (e.g. EIN, ITIN, VAT number).
A certificate, professional licence, or permit number, including driver's licence numbers.
A vehicle registration plate number.
A vehicle identification number (VIN) or equivalent serial identifier for a vehicle.
A bank, brokerage, utility, or other financial account number.
A bank routing, sort-code, or IBAN-style transit number.
A payment card number (PAN).
A payment card verification value.
A SWIFT or BIC bank identifier code.
A personal identification number used to authorize a card or account.
A medical record number (MRN) assigned by a provider.
A health-plan member, beneficiary, or subscriber number.
An ABO/Rh blood group.
A biometric measurement or template: fingerprint, iris, face, voice, gait, or similar.
A password or passphrase, including temporary and one-time values.
An API key, access token, or client secret.
An HTTP cookie name/value, including session cookies.
An IPv4 address.
An IPv6 address.
A network interface hardware (MAC) address.
A device serial number, IMEI, advertising ID, or equivalent hardware identifier.
A person's age. Ages over 89 are direct identifiers under HIPAA.
A date of birth.
A gender or sex value recorded for a person.
A racial or ethnic origin.
A religious or philosophical belief.
A political opinion or party affiliation.
Sexual orientation.
A language a person speaks or prefers.
An attained level of education or a named qualification.
Employment status such as employed, unemployed, retired, or student.
A person's job title, profession, or role.
A calendar date. Dates tied to an individual are direct identifiers under HIPAA.
A time of day.
A combined date and time value.
The name of a company, agency, institution, or other organization.
